name: Adopt Git Crafter
why: A repo, from copying the starters to running Git Crafter's CI and pages and staying current
ideal: A repo copies two starters and three CI files, pins Git Crafter to a full SHA, requires its check, and takes each release within days.

steps.name: Copy
steps.rule: Copy the starters, CI and pages callers and Dependabot entry; pin Git Crafter to a full SHA with its version.

steps.name: Require
tools: A ruleset on the default branch
steps.rule: The default branch requires ci / ci-ok, so every merge passes the standard.

steps.name: Update
steps.rule: Dependabot opens a bump of the pin as each Git Crafter release lands, and none waits for weeks.

steps.name: Check
tools: CI on the bump's pull request
steps.rule: CI checks a bump in minutes, so it can merge the same day.

steps.name: Current
steps.rule: Every action, Git Crafter's included, stays on its latest allowed release.
